text: This fault of not perceiving betimes and of not being sensible of the feebleness and extreme alteration that age naturally brings both upon body and mind... has lost the reputation of most of the great men in the world.
author: Michel de Montaigne
locator: Book II, Chapter 8, Of the Affection of Fathers to their Children
translation: Charles Cotton, ed. W. C. Hazlitt, 1877
